title: Super Cat: The Rooftop Rescue
description: A tiny demonstration of the reusable adventure format.

scenes.title: A Cry Across the Rooftops
scenes.text: Super Cat hears a kitten calling from a rooftop across the street.

scenes.title: The Great Leap
scenes.text: With a mighty bound, Super Cat lands beside the frightened kitten.

choices.text: Call for help from the rooftop.

scenes.title: The Fire Escape
scenes.text: Super Cat races up the old fire escape, arriving just in time.

choices.text: Guide the kitten down the stairs.

scenes.title: A Hero's Welcome
scenes.text: The kitten is home safe. The city cheers for its whiskered hero.
